canonical_units.label: Н/НН в производных наречиях и существительных: сохранять написание производящей основы там, где словообразовательная связь установлена
canonical_units.counting_policy: General derivational parent and independently counted child practice unit must not be double-counted. Final granularity remains denominator-materialization policy.
canonical_units.learner_policy: First establish part of speech and motivating word; do not transfer N/NN from a visually similar word blindly.

canonical_units.label: ТРУЖЕНИК, МАСЛЕНИЦА, ПУДРЕНИЦА, ГОСТИНИЦА, ПРИДАНОЕ: словарная школьная группа
canonical_units.learner_policy: Keep as a dictionary-practice group. Do not invent one shared derivational exception rule for all five; where current word formation is transparent, explain it separately.

canonical_units.label: Деепричастие и основное действие: общий субъект; безличная конструкция возможна при инфинитиве и совпадении субъекта действий
decision_model: In an ordinary personal clause, the gerund action and predicate action must belong to the same agent.
A gerund construction is permitted in an impersonal clause containing an infinitive when the gerund and infinitive imply the same agent.
An impersonal clause without such an infinitive does not license a dangling gerund merely by context.
canonical_units.learner_policy: Do not teach the obsolete absolute shortcut 'gerunds are impossible in impersonal sentences'.

canonical_units.label: ПРИ ЧЁМ / НИ ПРИ ЧЁМ / НИПОЧЁМ
decision_model: ПРИ ЧЁМ is a separate preposition+pronoun combination in the relational question pattern.
НИ ПРИ ЧЁМ is a fixed separate combination meaning noninvolvement.
НИПОЧЁМ is a lexicalized solid adverb/predicative word with its own meanings.
canonical_units.learner_policy: Do not choose spelling from pronunciation alone; distinguish the lexical construction.

canonical_units.label: ПОНЕМНОГУ, ПОМНОГУ, ПОДОЛГУ: слитная словообразовательная модель ПО- + основа наречия + -У
canonical_units.current_model: The final -о of the motivating adverb is truncated and prefix по- plus suffix -у form the derived adverb; current Gramota gives помногу, подолгу, понемногу among this model.
canonical_units.learner_policy: Replace the weak mnemonic 'not the ПО-...-ОМУ model' with the positive current word-formation model.
